name: Exa Search
description: Exa is an AI-native web search and content retrieval service for finding public pages, extracting page contents, locating similar sources, generating cited answers, and running bounded research.
agentUseSummary: Connect a customer-owned Exa API key through Relay. Agents may run bounded public-web searches, retrieve content for explicit public URLs, find similar pages, and generate cited answers; deep research and bulk extraction remain approval-gated.

credentialRequirements.name: EXA_API_KEY
credentialRequirements.label: Exa API key
credentialRequirements.helpText: Create a dedicated key in the Exa dashboard. Relay stores it encrypted and never exposes it to agent prompts, environment files, or tool results.

capabilities.label: Search
capabilities.description: Run bounded Exa searches over the public web and return source URLs with concise evidence.

capabilities.label: Contents
capabilities.description: Retrieve bounded text, highlights, or summaries for explicit public URLs.

capabilities.label: Find similar
capabilities.description: Find public pages similar to an explicit public URL.

capabilities.label: Answer
capabilities.description: Generate a bounded answer with source citations.

capabilities.label: Research
capabilities.description: Run broad or deep research workflows only after approval.

allowed.label: Search web
allowed.description: Run bounded Exa web searches for public-web evidence.

allowed.label: Fetch contents
allowed.description: Fetch bounded content for explicit public URLs.

allowed.label: Find similar pages
allowed.description: Find public pages similar to an explicit public URL.

allowed.label: Generate answer
allowed.description: Generate a bounded answer with source citations.

approvalRequired.label: Deep research
approvalRequired.description: Broad or deep research workflows require exact approval.

approvalRequired.label: Bulk extraction
approvalRequired.description: High-volume URL extraction or crawling requires exact approval.

approvalRequired.label: Export result sets
approvalRequired.description: Exporting large result sets outside the workspace requires exact approval.

blocked.label: Secret extraction
blocked.description: Searching for or exposing credentials, keys, tokens, or private data is blocked.

blocked.label: Private data harvesting
blocked.description: Bulk personal-data collection and login-protected scraping are blocked.

blocked.label: Access bypass
blocked.description: Bypassing paywalls, authentication, robots restrictions, or site access controls is blocked.

approvalProfiles.label: Search Operator
approvalProfiles.description: Bounded search, contents, similar-page, and answer calls run directly; deep research, bulk extraction, and exports require approval.

providerSetup.nextAction: Create a dedicated Exa API key, connect it through Relay, then verify health, bounded search, contents, similar-page and answer calls, approval-gated research, redaction, rotation, disconnect, and post-disconnect denial.

evidence.supports: Exa documents authenticated web search with bounded result counts, search modes, domain filters, publication and crawl-date filters, and optional returned contents.
Exa documents content retrieval for explicit URLs with text, highlights, summaries, subpages, and freshness controls.
Exa documents finding pages similar to a supplied URL with the same bounded filtering and content options.
